requirements.missing: No document provides a step-by-step pre-harvest field sampling protocol for chickpea yield estimation. None specifies sample plot size for yield estimation, number of replicates, timing relative to growth stages (e.g., R5-R7 pod-filling), criteria for selecting representative plants/branches, procedure for counting pods and seeds per plant, or method for determining average seed weight prior to harvest.

No document presents a dimensionally correct pre-harvest yield estimation formula with explicitly named measured inputs and their units (e.g., plants/m², fresh/dry weight in g, pod fill percentage) and a final yield unit in kg/ha or t/ha. s5 reports post-harvest grain yield in kg/ha and a harvest-index formula, but this applies to harvested plots, not pre-harvest estimation. s1 and s0 report trial yields in lb/acre but contain no estimation formula.
